title: Credit Memos to Plan Sponsors: Performance Guarantees, Billing Errors and the Implementation Credit (PBM Services Agreement)
content:
A credit memo lowers what a plan sponsor owes Northbridge Rx under its PBM Services Agreement and is applied against an invoice. This reference covers three grounds for a credit memo: a missed performance guarantee, a billing error, and the implementation credit.

## Performance guarantees

**Rule.** Performance is measured over each contract year: average speed to answer against the arrangement's guaranteed seconds, claims financial accuracy against the guaranteed accuracy, and home delivery turnaround against the guaranteed business days. Each missed guarantee earns the sponsor that guarantee's penalty amount as a credit memo within the arrangement's credit period, in calendar days, after the contract year ends. Guarantees met earn nothing, and penalties never exceed the listed amounts.

**Points of judgement.**

- The measurement period is the contract year; one result per guarantee per contract year.
- The three guarantees are judged separately: a year may miss one, two, all three or none, and each missed guarantee earns its own listed amount.
- A met guarantee earns no credit.
- The credit for a missed guarantee is the listed amount for that guarantee under the sponsor's arrangement, never more.
- The credit is issued as a credit memo within the credit period counted from the end of the contract year.

*Hypothetical year.* Under hypothetical listed amounts of 2000.00 (speed to answer), 3000.00 (claims accuracy) and 4000.00 (home delivery turnaround), a contract year in which speed to answer and home delivery turnaround are missed and claims accuracy is met earns two credit memos, 2000.00 and 4000.00, a total of 6000.00; the met accuracy guarantee earns nothing.

## Billing errors

Billing errors are credited when an invoice dispute is upheld.

## Implementation credit

The implementation credit of the arrangement's amount per enrolled employee is credited on the first administrative invoice after go-live. The credit is the per-employee amount multiplied by the enrolled employees.

*Hypothetical.* With a per-employee credit of 12.00 and 800 enrolled employees, the credit is 12.00 multiplied by 800, that is 9600.00 USD, applied on the first administrative invoice after go-live; an arrangement whose per-employee amount is 0.00 yields no implementation credit.

## Summary of grounds

| Ground | When it arises | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Missed performance guarantee | Contract year measured; issued within the credit period after the year ends | The listed amount for that guarantee, never more |
| Billing error | An invoice dispute is upheld | The billing error credited |
| Implementation credit | First administrative invoice after go-live | Per-employee amount multiplied by enrolled employees |
